mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuation and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 5.5% triggers a negative market reaction due to concerns about weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals strong aggregate demand, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through increased corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS show positive MoM growth, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained regime (INDPRO < 105 and FEDFUNDS > 3.5%), declining industrial production signals an impending recession, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 105 and FEDFUNDS > 3.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the past month indicates a strengthening labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 0.5% triggers inflation fears, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market anticipates monetary tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises above 0.5% MoM, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), a rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% triggers a negative market reaction due to the risk of a recession, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY and FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through reduced corporate investment and earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both INDPRO and HOUST decline, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.
